in_sanskrit.name: Mainul
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Moon
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Mainul एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Mainul is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'moon'. In Hindu mythology, the moon is considered a symbol of peace, tranquility, and calmness. It is also associated with the god Chandra, who is known for his wisdom and compassion.
